review:
Extra Juicy Megaways brings the fruit classic onto Megaways reels with a new kiwi symbol, a multiplier scatter and refreshed artwork. The number of ways changes every spin, so the steady line structure of the original is replaced by a more variable base game.

The bonus keeps the progressive-multiplier idea and adds a gamble feature inside the free spins, letting you try to unlock extra spins as the round continues. Pragmatic Play describes the game as high volatility and quotes a 5,000x maximum. The RTP is 96.42%. If the original felt too simple, this version adds more decisions and more swing.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
